verdict.rationale: Parahelp ships a guardrails layer: actions can be gated behind Slack human approval (for example, refunds above $100), and natural-language rules can transfer certain tickets to a human team. Simulations let you test agent behavior before release. These rules constrain what the agent does, but nothing in the evidence shows it is kept from inventing policies, prices, or promises, or that it declines off-knowledge questions. Missing for 10: knowledge-grounding or anti-hallucination controls, a documented safe-decline or escalate-when-unknown behavior for out-of-scope questions, and independent or hands-on evidence that invented answers are prevented.
